public.title: 3Sum
public.description: Return every distinct triplet of values from three distinct input indices whose sum is zero. Sort numbers within each triplet increasingly; sort the resulting triplets lexicographically by numeric values. Do not repeat duplicate triplets. values has 0 to 60 integers between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Sort first, then fix one value and move two pointers.
Skip duplicate fixed values and duplicate endpoint values.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: For each fixed value, two pointers exploit the sorted order to find complements without duplicate triplets. O(n²) time and O(n) auxiliary space plus output.
